subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- September 14, 2026
body:
Daily AcreetionOS Update - September 14, 2026

Dear AcreetionOS Community,

We're excited to share the latest developments and updates from the AcreetionOS project. As we continue to work towards making our Linux distribution the best it can be, we're grateful for your support and engagement.

In the past week, we've seen significant progress on various fronts. Our community members have been actively contributing to the project, and we're thrilled to see the growth and enthusiasm around AcreetionOS. We've had several commits to the codebase, including fixes for geocode-glib updates, improvements to the Calamares installer, and enhancements to our GitLab CI/CD pipelines.

One of the notable changes is the fix for the geocode-glib update conflict, which should resolve issues on installed systems. Additionally, we've seen commits related to Calamares configuration, including a preference for 1080p gfxmode over native 4k on boot. These changes will improve the overall user experience and ensure a smoother installation process.

We've also made significant progress on our GitLab instance, with updates to the `.gitlab-ci.yml` file for Secret Detection and SAST (Security, Compliance, and Vulnerability (SAST) analysis). These changes will help us maintain a secure and reliable codebase. Furthermore, we've pinned v0.3.0 archive checksums in the us-infra-hub repository, ensuring consistency and integrity of our infrastructure.

On the news front, we've got a few reminders and updates to share. The subscription price change for LWN subscriptions is approaching, with the new rates taking effect after September 15. Additionally, the 7.3-rc3 kernel prepatch is out for testing, and the EuroPython 2026 videos have been published.

We're proud to see our community members contributing to the project and making a positive impact. Your participation and feedback are invaluable to us, and we encourage you to continue sharing your ideas and suggestions.

As we move forward, we're committed to maintaining our focus on user experience, security, and community engagement. We're excited to see what the future holds for AcreetionOS and look forward to your continued support.

If you have any questions or would like to get involved, please don't hesitate to reach out to us on our Discord server or through our GitLab instance. We're always here to help and appreciate your enthusiasm for the project.

Thank you for being part of the AcreetionOS community, and we look forward to sharing more updates with you in the coming days.

Best regards,
Natalie Cole-Clift Spiva
Co-Lead Developer, AcreetionOS
